prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE full-body transparent visual novel game sprite by editing the supplied original project NAI master. Preserve EXACT same face proportions, eye color, hair silhouette/parting/accessories, costume, trim/buttons, socks/shoes and body proportions. Match its crisp variable ink contours, patterned hard cel shadows and subdued palette; no redesign or soft airbrush. New acting C03: genuine laughter, mouth open, shoulders loosened, one hand near mouth, no new props.  Entire body, top hair and both shoes inside empty transparent safe margins. One character only, anatomically correct hands. No scenery, glow, vignette, cast shadow, lettering, logos or furniture. Retain EVERY existing worn accessory, equipment, belt attachment and tool from the master. Do not add duplicate accessories or new held tools, weapons, fire or magic. Genuine transparent alpha outside silhouette. Portrait 1024x1536. Armband is plain red, no text or emblem; hanging belt ends have no writing. Same muscular build. Character temperament: Broad grounded muscular stance and protective blocking gestures; anger can be intimidating and fear can be stiff, not always heroic friendliness.
origin: one NAI master per character; does not use rejected NAI pose candidates
